title: Hydra-Enabled On-Chain Subscriptions & Pay-As-You-Go Micropayments: Open-Source Library for Cardano

ms.promise:
Project Initiation Report:
Hydra and Subscription Services Landscape Analysis:
・Comprehensive evaluation of the current landscape for scalable subscription and pay as you go services on blockchain.
・Identification of key challenges in implementing subscription models on existing blockchain infrastructures.

Technology Assessment:
・Analysis of existing blockchain Libraries and their applicability to high-frequency transactions and microtransactions.
・Review of Hydra’s capabilities in handling low-latency and high-throughput scenarios.
ms.criteria:
The report provides an in-depth understanding of the opportunities for utilizing Hydra in subscription and and pay as you go based models.
Includes a comparative study showcasing Hydra’s advantages in terms of transaction speed, cost reduction, and scalability.
Clearly identifies the project's scope, objectives, and potential to optimize subscription and and pay as you go based services on Cardano.

Detailed outline of the technical requirements for developing the subscription and pay-as-you-go Library with Hydra integration.
Identification of APIs, data flows, and integration points for seamless subscription services on Cardano.
Challenges in achieving high-throughput and trustlessness, with proposed solutions.

Comprehensive architecture diagram of the Library, illustrating how Hydra is leveraged for scalability and instant settlements.
Specifications for smart contracts, payment models, and subscription management tools.

Library Prototype:
A functional prototype demonstrating key features such as:
・Seamless integration of Hydra for fast, low-cost microtransactions.
・Secure smart contract management of pay-as-you-go models.

Sandboxed Testing Environment:
A secure testing environment configured to validate the Library’s scalability, functionality, and security using simulated subscription transactions.
Testing of smart contracts, backend APIs, and integrations for security, functionality, and performance.
Validation of subscription transactions in simulated environments.
ms.criteria:
The prototype showcases the core features, including Hydra’s role in scaling subscription services with instant settlement.
Demonstrates the ease of integration with existing dApps through the provided API toolkit.
Stable Sandboxed Testing:
The sandbox operates reliably with no major bugs or security vulnerabilities.
Successfully replicates real-world subscription use cases, validating the effectiveness of the Library.
All components are thoroughly tested, with identified issues resolved.
